profile.summary: East Bay Municipal Utility District (EBMUD) is a public water utility in the East Bay of California. It provides drinking water for about 1.5 million customers and also manages wastewater systems and related infrastructure. It also runs summer internship programs for high school students.

sources.title: About us - East Bay Municipal Utility District

Summary is neutral and supported.
